constraints.name: professional_profiles_education_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN (jsonb_typeof((details -> 'education'::text)) = 'array'::text) THEN (jsonb_array_length((details -> 'education'::text)) <= 5)
    ELSE false
END)

constraints.name: professional_profiles_experience_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN (jsonb_typeof((details -> 'experience'::text)) = 'array'::text) THEN (jsonb_array_length((details -> 'experience'::text)) <= 5)
    ELSE false
END)

constraints.name: professional_profiles_keys_check
